title: Two Assistant Professor Positions in Economics for Junior Candidates
industry: Economics, Economics and Social Sciences, Econometrics, Statistics and Quantitative Methods (JEL C), General Economics (JEL A), Economic Thought & Methodology (JEL B)
text:
Key information:
This early-career position is intended for candidates whose PhD in Economics, Finance, or a closely related field was conferred on or after 1 September 2023. For candidates with documented career interruptions that prevented research activity (e.g., parental leave, long-term illness, or comparable circumstances), the cutoff date will be moved back by the length of the interruption.
Applications are welcome from candidates working in any field of economics.
The appointment is for an eight-year tenure-track contract. Candidates may be considered for promotion to a tenured position at any time before the end of the contract, subject to successful evaluation.
Compensation and teaching responsibilities are competitive with those offered by other leading European institutions, with a minimum gross annual salary of 100,000 euros. The final remuneration package will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications and overall professional profile, in accordance with the University's principles of equity, transparency and non-discrimination governing its compensation policies.
Candidates should demonstrate a strong record of, or clear potential for excellence in research and teaching.
Applications must be submitted through the online form available at: https://jobmarket.unibocconi.eu/?id=987
The application deadline is Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 23:59 Central European Summer Time (CEST).
Candidates are required to provide the contact details of three highly qualified academic referees. Each referee will automatically receive an email from the system with instructions to upload their reference letter directly.
Additional information:

• Applicants whose Ph.D. was conferred before September 1, 2023, should apply through Bocconi University’s separate call for Experienced Assistant Professor positions in Economics, which is available following this link: https://jobmarket.unibocconi.eu/?id=976.
